dialogues.jp: 頑張るんだよ、と暦先生が気のない声で言う。
dialogues.en: Work hard, Koyomi's unencouraging voice implied.
dialogues.text: Work hard, Koyomi's unencouraging voice implied.

dialogues.jp:
週番の号令がかかり、必要最小限のＨＲが終わ
る。
dialogues.en:
After assigning the weekly duties, Koyomi-sensei ended the
little-needed HR session.
dialogues.text:
After assigning the weekly duties, Koyomi-sensei ended the
little-needed HR session.

dialogues.jp:
はぁぁぁぁぁっ……いよいよ明日は試験だ。暦
先生は『がんばるんだよ』とか、気の無い声で
言って教室を後にした。
dialogues.en:
Haaaaaaah... in just one day's time, exams will start.
Koyomi-sensei gave us a half-hearted "work hard" before
leaving the classroom.
